text: Investigating fixed texture layouts before implementation: retain a valid cyclic anchor across color changes, omit the constant-face collapsed UV optimization when the qualified sampler is active, and promote only faces whose retained anchor becomes invalid to persistent midpoint subdivision. This would trade bounded monotonic geometry growth for eliminating recurring UV/native-mesh work while preserving final-RGB interpolation. First measure actual retained-anchor invalidations on the original cortical dump; no scientific-model or rendering-source change yet.
